[RLOW.8.1.3] **Sample absorption is an engine step, not a
compiled rule.** The compiler emits the backend atoms and
lowers each read to its aggregation call ([RLOW.8.1.4]); it synthesises **no**
rule for absorption. The engine absorbs once per pump, after
the agenda drains, per [LSER.8.6].

What the compiler does still owe the engine is the keying: the
per-(schema, slot, identity-value) backend state is keyed as the aggregation
reads it ([RLOW.8.2.1]).
